active_roadmap.title: Roadmap cockpit-v3: COCKPIT shows what the nightly routine and the next deploy need

items.outcome: one page shows, per project, the last nightly package-update pull request, the held packages with their issue, and the key `@softure-ai` versions against the newest on npm

one page shows, per app, the last release and deploy, the merged changes since that release, and the required secrets added since the last deploy, so a deploy that would stop at the secret check shows before it runs
a project whose forge has a release newer than its `waiting: release` rows, or whose finished roadmap is still live, is flagged on the overview and its project page
owner steps the nightly routine records (held packages, new secrets) arrive in the inbox and the owner settles each with a "done" answer

open_changes.title: Each app shows what waits for its deploy
Context drift against the forge is flagged
Nightly package updates in one view
Routine owner steps are answered in the inbox

owner_queue.text: **CMP-12**: turn the digest on: in Resend verify the sending domain and create an API key; in the `production` environment set the secrets `RESEND_API_KEY` and `MAILING_UNSUBSCRIBE_SECRET` (`openssl rand -base64 32`) and `DIGEST_RECIPIENTS` (the key secret `SOFTURE_EMAIL_KEY_SECRET` is its own entry below, set before the next release), and the variables `MAIL_FROM` and optionally `DIGEST_AT`; after the next deploy the run checks the first digest and its unsubscribe link (README, "The digest in production"). Today these secrets are empty (deploy run 45253324744).

**CMP-18**: to publish the CLI, store a granular npm token (read and write on the `@softure-ai` scope) as `NPM_TOKEN` in the `npm` environment and give the word to publish `@softure-ai/cockpit` 0.7.0 (`publish-cli` has never run)
**CMP-20**: to invite teammates, run `npx softure-deploy run --host=<ssh alias> grant-role --email=<owner> --role=admin --commit`; the invitation mail needs the digest's mail settings above

**CMP-21** (optional): to show health from observability, set the variable `GRAFANA_URL` and the secret `GRAFANA_TOKEN` (a Grafana service account that may read alert rules) in the `production` environment; today `GRAFANA_TOKEN` is empty

**CV-2**: for each watched repository (COCKPIT included) install the Claude GitHub App and create the owner-word wake scheduled task from `@softure-ai/skills` `routines/owner-word-wake.md` → "Setting it up" (GitHub event trigger on the repository's issues, opened and labeled; a fresh session on every fire; the routine prompt from that file), then set `autonomy.ownerWordWake` to `"routine"` in that repository's `context/workflow.json`; COCKPIT shows "Wakes on its own" after its next scan (README, "Owner-word issues that wake their project")

owner step: give the word to release cockpit-v2 (**CV-1** to **CV-4**, merged on master and archived here when cockpit-v3 opened on 2026-11-24); the release reads this file, and `wt-roadmap.py released <tag>` settles the rows afterwards
